items.name: a rusty sword
items.description: An old sword covered in rust. It is still sharp enough to be useful.

items.name: a loaf of bread
items.description: Freshly baked and still warm. It smells wonderful.

items.name: a brass lantern
items.description: A small lantern of brass. There is still some oil in it.

items.name: an iron key
items.description: A heavy iron key. Which door could it open?

items.name: a shiny shell
items.description: It shimmers in every colour. If you hold it to your ear, you hear the lake.

items.name: a red mushroom
items.description: Red with white spots. Probably better not to eat it.

items.name: an old bone
items.description: A long, gnawed bone. Something with big teeth has been here.
